inputs.name: reviewCacheKey.snapshot
inputs.description: A review snapshot containing the target, supplied inputs, serialized state, context hash, context paths, and omitted paths. The key uses only state and contextHash, so changes to the other snapshot fields do not affect it.

inputs.name: reviewCacheKey.settings
inputs.description: The clean-code settings object included in full in the cache-key serialization. Its JSON-serialized fields participate in the key; the implementation does not apply separate normalization here.

inputs.name: readReviewCache.root
inputs.description: Project root used to resolve .cache/harness/clean-code for lookup. The read requires resolvable real paths and returns undefined if directory resolution or any later read step fails.

inputs.name: readReviewCache.key
inputs.description: Cache key used as the <key>.json lookup filename. Only a reviewCacheKey digest (64 lowercase hexadecimal characters) is accepted; any other key, such as one with path segments, is a cache miss and returns undefined without touching the filesystem.

inputs.name: writeReviewCache.root
inputs.description: Project root used to resolve .cache/harness/clean-code for cache creation. The write checks the nearest existing cache ancestor against the project root, and any failure is swallowed.

inputs.name: writeReviewCache.key
inputs.description: Cache key used in the temporary and final cache filenames. Only a reviewCacheKey digest (64 lowercase hexadecimal characters) is accepted; any other key, such as one with path segments, is ignored and nothing is written.

inputs.name: writeReviewCache.value
inputs.description: Evaluation data serialized into the cache file; evaluation is required and localization is optional. Serialization or filesystem failures are swallowed so cache availability does not determine whether a review succeeds.

outputs.name: reviewCacheKey
outputs.description: A lowercase SHA-256 digest used as the review cache key. It hashes the provider URL, rubric version, complete settings object, snapshot state, and snapshot context hash.

outputs.name: readReviewCache
outputs.description: Resolves to the parsed JSON stored for the key when the resolved file remains inside the project cache directory. It resolves to undefined on missing files, escaped paths, invalid JSON, or any caught read error; parsed values are not schema-validated.

outputs.name: writeReviewCache
outputs.description: Resolves to void after attempting to serialize the evaluation and rename the temporary file to the key cache filename. All failures are caught, so this operation does not reject for cache errors.

errors.name: CacheOutsideProjectError
errors.description: The internal cache-directory guards throw this error when the resolved cache directory or nearest existing ancestor is outside the project root. readReviewCache and writeReviewCache catch it, so it does not escape those exported operations.
